title: docs(skills): the checked action examples drop their locations key
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoEfAeSobHZgSLfHP3844ZfC)_

Part of #37895

This is PR 1 of 2 on that card. It lands before #36495 (draft PR #37929), so that #37929's `check:skill-examples` and `check:skill-served-sections` go green. PR 2, the teaching of the new words, stays behind #36495.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:写应用的 AI 助手读到的七个按钮示例,不再写明按钮放在哪里;说明文字和位置对照表一字未动,也没有教任何新词。
- 为什么做:这是「按钮位置改用新词」这项工作的前置一步。旧的位置词即将退役,这七个示例不先让路,那项改动的两道示例检查过不了。
- 出错会怎样:照抄示例的人会得到一个哪里都不显示的按钮,校验时有一条提醒告诉他补上位置;本改动只删了几行,可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:在「按钮位置改用新词」那项改动之前合并本改动(技能包属于要你亲手合并的范围)。

## What changes

Seven checked examples in the published skills drop their `locations` key. Nine old words leave compiled text; no word is added.

| File | Example | Line on the base | Words dropped |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` | `ask_about_contract` (os:check) | 189 | `record_header` |
| `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` | `mark_done`, § Actions, JSON fence 1 | 136 | `record_header` |
| `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` | `crm_reassign_lead` (os:check) | 69 | `record_header`, `list_item` |
| `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` | `crm_convert_lead` (os:check) | 96 | `record_header`, `list_item` |
| `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` | `crm_print_a3` (os:check) | 180 | `record_header` |
| `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` | `crm_open_invoice_pdf` (os:check) | 205 | `record_header` |
| `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` | `crm_add_invoice_line` (os:check) | 239 | `record_header` |

Two more files move because the gates measure them as owed:

- `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: three rows follow their files down to the measurement (6799 to 6791, 2264 to 2256, 3890 to 3844). The gate refuses a ceiling above its file's measurement.
- `.changeset/37895-skills-action-examples-no-location-key.md`: a `patch` for `@objectstack/skills`, which ships the catalog.

Not changed: every sentence, the location table (`actions.md` lines 17 to 26), the `actionLayout` paragraph, `actions.md` line 222, `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md`, `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md` and the eval fixtures. None of them is compiled, and they are PR 2's.

## Why

On #37929's branch the action location vocabulary is `list`, `record`, `record_page`, `record_row`, `record_related`, `record_section`. On main it is `list_toolbar`, `list_item`, `record_header`, `record_more`, `record_related`, `record_section`. The only words both accept are `record_related` and `record_section`, and neither means a record-header button. So each example drops the key instead of taking a word with a different meaning.

## Size of the published skills

| Reading | Lines before | Lines after | Tokens before | Tokens after |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` | 487 | 486 | 6799 | 6791 |
| `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` | 165 | 165 | 2264 | 2256 |
| `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` | 266 | 261 | 3890 | 3844 |
| Bundle: all 14 `SKILL.md` files | 4959 | 4958 | 65451 | 65435 |
| Authored files the ratchet prices | n/a | n/a | 199689 | 199627 |

Net change under `skills/`: 1 line added, 7 removed. Tokens are the ratchet's own count, `ceil(utf8 bytes / 4)` with the release-stamp line left out.

## Tests

All readings are at head `661e8e90`, on base `f926dfab` (origin/main when the worktree was made).

<details>
<summary>Main-based tree: the two spec gates and the token ratchet</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples`: exit 0. `352 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-served-sections`: exit 0. `24 served section(s), each heading exactly once in its file (6 json, 2 json+ts, 16 neutral); 10 JSON fence(s) parse and pass their spec validators.`
- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: exit 0. `61 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings`. Before the three rows moved it was exit 1, `3 of 114 published bundle file(s) failed their check`, each row above its measurement (by 8, 8 and 46).
- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs --self-test`: exit 0. `111 cases pass`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 scripts/platform-catalog.test.ts` (the one test file that names the ratchet script): `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 20 passed (20)`.

</details>

<details>
<summary>#37929's branch at e3b2ea95: red before these edits, green with them</summary>

Method: a second worktree, detached at `e3b2ea95`. `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/client` and `@objectstack/client-react` were built there (turbo, 47 tasks). The gates ran once on the untouched tree, as the control. Then this PR's `skills/` diff was applied with `git apply`, and the gates ran again. The two `objectstack-ui` files were byte-identical to this PR's head after the apply.

- Control, `check:skill-served-sections`: exit 1. `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md § Actions: JSON fence 1 is refused as Action: locations.0`.
- Control, `check:skill-examples`: exit 1. Eight `TS2322` errors, at `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md:189:15` and `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` 69:15, 69:32, 96:15, 96:32, 180:15, 205:15, 239:15.
- With the edits, `check:skill-served-sections`: exit 0. `10 JSON fence(s) parse and pass their spec validators.`
- With the edits, `check:skill-examples`: exit 0. `352 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s)`.

The token ratchet on that tree stays red on that branch's own three rows until main, with this PR in it, is merged there. That is not a reading about this PR.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Derived gate families: 68 derived, 67 run, 1 not measured</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 68 commands for the 5 changed paths. Each was run with its exit code recorded before any pipe, and `--ran` answered: `68 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 67 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`.

- 67 commands: exit 0.
- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, reason: exit 3, `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`. It reads the `dist/` of every package and this tree built only the three packages above. The diff changes no package source, so this one is CI's.
- `check:skill-examples` is outside the derived list; it was run because the order names it.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The examples now show an action with no placement.** The text above them still says that an action with neither `locations` nor a list view naming it renders nowhere, and the Ask AI paragraph still says to declare the action in `locations`. An action copied from one of these seven examples as it stands draws the `action-no-placement` warning at `os validate` and no button. No sentence was added to say so: the order set a budget of zero added lines and no new word. PR 2 gives each example its placement again, in the new words. Carrier: PR 2 on this card.
- **The token rows are banked.** The three ceilings are 62 tokens lower in total. When PR 2 writes `locations` back, those three files grow again. The ratchet's header gives one path for a row to go up: restatement cut from the same file first, then the measured remainder, with the standing ruling quoted in the PR body.
- **A sibling branch deletes the Ask AI block.** `claude/project-thread-q0nzop` (no pull request yet) removes the whole block that holds the first row of the table above. Whichever lands second takes the deletion and pins `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`'s row at its new measurement; that row is a hand-read conflict.
- **Old words that stay.** `git grep` for the four retired words under `skills/` still finds prose, the location table and eval fixtures. They are not compiled and they are PR 2's.
- **Main moved after the base.** origin/main went from `f926dfab` to `a3c229ea` during the run. None of the five files changed there and `git merge-tree` reports a clean merge. The readings above were not repeated on the merged tree.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:

1. `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md`, the hunk at line 136. This JSON is served to clients by the hosted door, and it is the one example in a section whose headline is that a write button needs a placement.
2. `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`, the hunks at lines 69 and 96. Each dropped two words, a header placement and a row placement.
3. `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, the three rows. Each new number is the gate's own measurement.

Two-minute check, no build needed: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-served-sections`. Expect the last line to end with `10 JSON fence(s) parse and pass their spec validators.` and exit 0.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No schema changes.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (No name added.)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran. `pnpm lint` is CI's on this PR.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
